notes.title: 3.7 update
notes.notes:
Hello coners, another epicly cone-filled update is ready for your enjoyment! Enjoy cones in space 3.7!

-Added nuclear reactors
-Added nuclear anode type
-fixed wooden rafts crashing the game
-added search bar in the hotbar menu
-you can now ubercharge machines using nuclear energy
-fixed engie goggles not working
-optimized engie goggle drawing

Additionally, we would like to start looking into porting the game to linux systems, if you have a linux system and are interested please email us or dm us on discord!

Thanks and enjoy the update!

notes.title: 3.6 update/patch
notes.notes:
A new update/patch is ready to go for cones in space! The following changes and additions have been made:

-Made machines more user friendly
-fixed lighting bugs on the moon and a few other planets
-fixed pollution causing lighting bugs
-fixed a potential softlock on the spring planet
-fixed aphotic plane portal being able to
	send you to the nexus
-tier 4 and above rockets are no longer needed
	to land on nexus planets
-tier 4 and above rockets are no longer needed
	to exit the nexus rift
-tier 4 and above rockets are no longer needed
	to exit the blue wormhole
-when stuck inside walls you are now pushed up to prevent
	softlocks
-the conemarker now decreases orbit radius when you look
	down
-compressor is less janky(?)

Hope you all enjoy the update, also make sure to try out the machines as now they should function properly. Additionally, lcc has been removed from challenge mode due to the dlc we are working on, don't worry, it will return!

notes.title: Major update devlog 1
notes.notes:
what's up coners? the new major update for cones in space! In this handy dandy steam update I will inform you all on the coney goodness we have in store for you in the coming future...

The combat system in cones in space is getting reworked!
lets face it.. the combat is complete garbage, so I've revamped the entire thing, and have added sound effects for when you hit something! the environment also reacts to you breaking stuff down so the game will hopefully feel more alive, critical hits have been added as well! Every time you hit an enemy there's a 1 in 30 chance of getting a critical hit, however some items will allow you to increase this chance or get guaranteed crits 

new planets!
a significant amount of new planets are being added! Really no new planets have been added since 2.5 so it's something that's long overdue

that's all the beanage I'm spilling for this post! Stay tuned for one of the top ten greatest cones in space updates of all time...
